for.zh: 騎車開車的人：依你實際騎多少、怎麼騎來算保費；保你撞到別人、車子受損和被偷
for.en: Riders and drivers: priced on how much and how you really ride; covers hitting someone, damage to your vehicle and theft

questions.en: What is it worth now, roughly?
Years since you got your licence?

questions.zh: 過去三年有幾次是你的責任的事故？
questions.en: At-fault accidents in the last three years?

questions.zh: 一個月大約騎（開）多少公里？
questions.en: About how many km a month?

questions.zh: 願意讓 Cover 的 App 記錄行程來算保費嗎？（不記錄位置，只記里程、急煞、超速和夜間行駛的次數）
questions.en: Let Cover's app record your trips to price your cover? (no locations: only distance, hard braking, speeding and night riding counts)

options.zh: 只保撞到別人（第三人責任）
第三人責任＋竊盜＋自己的車損
options.en: Third party, theft and damage to your own vehicle

coverages.zh: 第三人責任（撞到人、撞壞別人的車或東西）
coverages.en: Third party (injuring someone, damaging their vehicle or property)

coverages.zh: 自己的車碰撞、刮傷、天災損壞
coverages.en: Your vehicle's collision, scratches and storm damage

addons.zh: 道路救援（拖吊 20 公里、送油、換胎、接電）
addons.en: Roadside help (a 20 km tow, fuel, a tyre change, a jump start)

claims.zh: 停車時被刮傷或撞到（不知道是誰）
claims.en: Scratched or hit while parked (unknown who)

claims.zh: 我撞壞別人的車或東西
claims.en: I damaged someone else's vehicle or property

clauses.zh: 「承保車輛」指保單所載車牌號碼之車輛。「駕駛人」指經你允許使用承保車輛、持有有效駕照之人。
clauses.en: The "insured vehicle" is the one with the plate on the policy. A "driver" is anyone with a valid licence using it with your permission.

clauses.zh: 「駕駛分數」由行程紀錄計算（0–100），依每百公里的急煞、急加速、超速及夜間 0–5 時行駛的次數扣分。分數每月更新，下個月的保費依此調整，最多調降 20%、調升 25%。
clauses.en: The "driving score" (0 to 100) comes from trip records: points off per 100 km for hard braking, hard acceleration, speeding and riding between midnight and 5 am. It updates monthly and next month's premium moves with it, down by up to 20% or up by up to 25%.

clauses.zh: 駕駛人使用承保車輛，因意外致第三人死亡、受傷或財物損失，依法應負賠償責任時，我們代為賠償，每一事故最高 15 萬美元（強制險給付的部分除外）。
clauses.en: When a driver of the insured vehicle is legally liable for someone else's death, injury or property damage in an accident, we pay, up to $150,000 per event (beyond what compulsory insurance pays).

clauses.zh: 承保車輛整車失竊，自報案日起 30 日內未尋回者，我們依車輛現值扣除 10% 自負額理賠。尋回時車輛有損壞者，依 CR-2.3 處理。
clauses.en: If the insured vehicle is stolen and not found within 30 days of the police report, we pay its current value less a 10% deductible. If it is found damaged, CR-2.3 applies.

clauses.zh: 承保車輛因碰撞、傾覆、刮損、他人惡意破壞、颱風或淹水而受損，我們支付修理費用扣除 100 美元自負額，以車輛現值為上限。修理費超過現值 75% 者，視為全損，依現值理賠。
clauses.en: When the insured vehicle is damaged by a collision, rolling over, scratches, vandalism, a typhoon or flooding, we pay the repair less a $100 deductible, up to its current value. A repair over 75% of the value counts as a total loss, paid at value.

clauses.zh: 酒後駕駛（吐氣酒精濃度達每公升 0.15 毫克以上）、吸毒、無照駕駛、駕照被吊扣期間駕駛，或肇事逃逸，不予理賠；但第三人的損害我們仍先行賠付，再向駕駛人求償。
clauses.en: No payment when driving over the alcohol limit (0.15 mg/L of breath), on drugs, without a licence or while it is suspended, or after leaving the scene; we still pay the other party first, then recover it from the driver.

clauses.zh: 競速、營業載客載貨（含外送平台）、故意行為，以及輪胎、零件的自然耗損，不予理賠。
clauses.en: No payment for racing, carrying passengers or goods for pay (delivery apps too), damage on purpose, or wear of tyres and parts.

clauses.zh: 未上鎖或鑰匙留在車上時的失竊，不予理賠。
clauses.en: No payment for theft while the vehicle was unlocked or the key was left in it.

clauses.zh: 發生事故後應立即報警並通知我們；涉及他人受傷或對方不同意和解時，須有警方的道路交通事故證明。單方事故請提供現場照片。
clauses.en: After an accident, call the police and tell us at once; when someone is hurt or the other party disagrees, we need the police accident report. For an accident with no one else, give photos of the scene.

clauses.zh: 修理前應先提供估價單，經我們同意後再修理；緊急必要的拖吊不在此限。
clauses.en: Get a repair quote and our agreement before repairs, except an urgent tow.

clauses.zh: 提供不實資料、偽造行程紀錄或讓未申報之主要駕駛人使用者，我們得拒絕理賠並終止保單。
clauses.en: False information, faked trip records, or an undeclared main driver lets us refuse the claim and end the policy.

clauses.zh: 道路救援：每年 4 次，拖吊 20 公里內免費、送油、換備胎、接電。
clauses.en: Roadside help: 4 times a year, a free tow up to 20 km, fuel, a spare tyre fitted, a jump start.

clauses.zh: 保費月繳，啟用行程紀錄者每月依駕駛分數調整。月繳扣款失敗有 14 日寬限期，逾期停效，補繳後復效。可隨時退保，按未經過日數退費。保費的 20% 為 Cover 的固定費用，其餘進入理賠池；年度結算後剩餘捐給你選的公益團體。
clauses.en: Paid monthly; with trip records, adjusted each month by the driving score. A failed payment has 14 days' grace, then lapses until paid. Cancel any time for a refund of the days left. 20% of the premium is Cover's flat fee, the rest the claims pool; what is left after the year goes to your chosen cause.
